segments.sn1.15:1.3: Saṇateva brahāraññaṃ [mahāraññaṃ (ka. sī. syā. kaṃ. ka.)], taṃ bhayaṃ paṭibhāti man”ti.
segments.sn1.15:2.3: Saṇateva brahāraññaṃ, sā rati paṭibhāti man”ti.

lines: Nidāghasamayasmiñhi ṭhitamajjhanhikakāle catuppadagaṇesu ceva pakkhīgaṇesu ca sannisinnesu vātapūritānaṃ susirarukkhānañceva chiddaveṇupabbānañca khandhena khandhaṃ sākhāya sākhaṃ saṅghaṭṭayantānaṃ pādapānañca araññamajjhe mahāsaddo uppajjati.
Taṃ bhayaṃ paṭibhāti manti taṃ evarūpe kāle mahāaraññassa saṇamānaṃ mayhaṃ bhayaṃ hutvā upaṭṭhāti.
Dandhapaññā kiresā devatā tasmiṃ khaṇe attano nisajjaphāsukaṃ kathāphāsukaṃ dutiyakaṃ alabhantī evamāha.
Yasmā pana tādise kāle piṇḍapātapaṭikkantassa vivitte araññāyatane kammaṭṭhānaṃ gahetvā nisinnassa bhikkhuno anappakaṃ sukhaṃ uppajjati, yaṃ sandhāya vuttaṃ –
Amānusī ratī hoti, sammā dhammaṃ vipassato”ti.(dha. pa.373) ca,
“Purato pacchato vāpi, aparo ce na vijjati;
Atīva phāsu bhavati, ekassa vasato vane”ti.(theragā.537) ca;
Tattha sā rati paṭibhāti manti yā evarūpe kāle ekakassa nisajjā nāma, sā rati mayhaṃ upaṭṭhātīti attho.
Ṭhite majjhanhiketi pubbaddhaṃ nikkhamitvā aparaddhaṃ appatvā ṭhitamajjhanhe.
Sabbasattānanti sabbesañca āhārūpajīvitasattānaṃ ghammatāpane santattakāyānaṃ iriyāpathadubbalyakāloti ṭhānādiiriyāpathassa asamatthakālo.
Saṇati viyāti saddaṃ karoti viya, yathā taṃ aññampi mahāvanaṃ vakkhamānanayena.
